translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: PINUUNGAN
book.title: PINUUNGAN to mgo Apostoles ni Disas Krays

content: Dos Kod-ampoo to mgo Judio ki Pablo

To id lihad don kos limmon allow, iddos mowwet no ponguu to mgo tohodbuwis no si Ananias duma taddot dumon od pombuyyahon to mgo Judio woy dos obugadu no si Tertulo, mid undiyon sikandin to ki Gubernador Felix amoy'd popenek to kasu ki Pablo.

De-en to kodpo-umow ni Gubernador Felix ki Pablo, id tigkanoy si Tertulo nid ponudtuu taddot saa no nopuungan kun ni Pablo. Kahi rin to, “Od bontuhon no Gubernador, iddos kotuihan du to kodponguu, nokovoggoy konami to mosunay no ko-ubpa daom to mowwet no timpu. Mo-uraa mandad kos nopuungan du no nokopo-udsuu ka-ay'n ingod.
De-en dakkoo kos kodposolamat doy kikow woy dii roy en ini od kolingawan ahad kannu.
Na, pomon to konna koy od kopiyan nod pokolewang kikow, od buyuwon doy nod pominoggon du pa sinahaw inis moobbava nod osengon doy.

Su nokita roy no inin minuvu, oray'd pokosamuk woy sikandin kos id bovaa to langun no ukahan diyot mgo Judio ka-ay to intirut ingod. Sikandin mandad kos ponguu to mgo minuvu no id ikuu taddot pomokayon nod ngoranan no Nazareno.
Konna ra idda, ahad pa iddos templo, od libmitan din nanoy, piru id ammot doy sikandin. [Na, od hukuman doyd nanoy sikandin ukit to konamin pomokayon,
piru id inguma si Lisias no ponguu to mgo sundau woy id ahaw rin si Pablo ka-ay't konami.

Woy id ikahi sikandin no ko ondoy iddos duwon id popenek no saa no nopuungan ni Pablo, ko-ilangan no ka-ay kun to kikow od po-usoy.] Otid intud-inturan du inin minuvu, od kosorollan du no mooggot en iddos langun nid ikahi roy no nokopuung sikandin to saa.”
Na iddos duma rin no mgo Judio, id lonug mandad to kod-ampoo ki Pablo, woy id ikahi no mooggot en idda langun.
Dos Kodtavak ni Pablo taddot Kod-ampoo Kandin

Nopongnga idda, id sinyasan taddot gubernador si Pablo nod ooseng. De-en mid ikahi si Pablo to, “Gubernador, nokosaddoo a no sikkow kos ponguu woy tohodhukum konami no mgo Judio daom to mo-uraa ron no lahun. De-en oray a no nahaa nod poko-ooseng ka-ay't isowwan du amoy'd pokotavak taddot id ampoo ran koddi.
Otid intud-intud ka, od kosorollan du no konna pa lampas to sopuu-oruwon allow pomon to kod-undiyon ku to Jerusalem amoy'd simba.
Na rutun, konna bonnaa no nokita a to inin mgo Judio no id apuu a to ahad ondoy riyot templo, woy waa a mandad id bovaa to ukahan diyot mgo simba-an to Judio o ahad ingkon no sakup taddon bonuwa.
Waa en id pokopokita ran kikow no posivonnaa taddot id ampoo ran koddi.

Piru iyon id pokoponudtuu ku no id simba a en diyot Monama to konamin kovuyyahan ukit to kod-ikuu to nonaw moka-atag ki Disas, woy idda en kos ikohiyon dan no uhus no nonaw. Id pomakoy a mandad taddot langun no Suhu ni Moises woy dos id sulat dangan to mgo propeta.
Iddos ko-immanan ku riyot Monama, nokod-iling da en taddot ko-immanan ka-ay'n mgo minuvu no od bodnawon din iddos langun nid poomatoy, motallong man o mosaasaa.
Ini en kos unayan no od nokkaanokkaa a inaayun nod puung to moppiya, su amoy od kosorollan ku no ollog kos koddin pinuungan diyot isowwan to Monama woy riyot langun no minuvu.

“Na, iddos unayan no id undiyon a to Jerusalem su pila ron man no lahun no waa a nokolowwi rutun. De-en id livod a rutun amoy'd piyod to mgo soopi no id tavang to mgo worowora woy amoy od boggoy a to buwis diyot templo.
To nopongnga ku puungi riyot templo iddos od puungan atag to kodlinis, id inguma kos mgo Judio laggun tid bovuwis a rutun. Woy iddon timpu, waa samuk woy disok da kos mgo minuvu.
Iddon mgo minuvu, mgo Judio no toho Asia. Sikandan nanoy kos ollog nod undinit kikow woy od popenek to kasu ko duwon man nokita ran no saa no nopuungan ku.
Piru pomon to waa man sikandan dini, po-osengow inis mgo minuvu no ka-ay ko-ungkay ko ondan kos saa no nokita ran iddot timpu no id intud-inturan a riyot isowwan to mgo tohodhukum.

Oyyos waa ossa nod ko-oseng dan no nopuungan ku no saa, idda ra en so laggun to id lohinat a riyot isowwan dan, mid ikahi a no, ‘Iddos unayan no id intud-inturan a ko-ungkay, su id pomakoy a nod bodnawon to Monama iddos id poomatoy ron.’ ”

Na si Gubernador Felix, dakkoo kos sinorollan din taddot nonaw moka-atag ki Disas no od ikulon tod pompomakoy. De-en id tampod din iddos kodpominog to kasu, woy kahi rin to, “Gali kud od ipongngan kos kodhukum to kasu row otid inguma ron si Lisias no ponguu to mgo sundau.”

Nopongnga idda, id suhu rin iddos kopitan to mgo sundau no od tomongngan si Pablo, piru od boggayan dad sikandin to disok no kolegguangan, woy dii mandad od suggan iddos mgo oukuy rin nod atod to mgo ko-ilonganon din.
Si Pablo riyot Isowwan ni Felix woy Drusila
To id lihad kos pilon allow pomon tadda, id livod diyot polasyu si Gubernador Felix duma taddot sawa rin no si Drusila
no sokkad no Judio. Na, id po-umow rin si Pablo, woy id pominog sikandin taddot kodpaabbotlabbot ni Pablo moka-atag to kopomakoy ki Disas Krays.

Piru laggun tid ooseng si Pablo moka-atag to motallong no kodbovotasan, woy dos kodtohoo to ingowollon to lawa woy moka-atag taddot od ingumon allow to kodhukum, no-od-oratan sikandin woy id osengan din si Pablo to, “Ollog pa ruwon! Otid pokolugaa a, id po-umow ku rad mandon sikkow.”
Piru iyon bonnaa tadda, id aangat sikandin nod boggayan ni Pablo to soopi amoy'd pokolegguang don sikandin diyot prisuwan. De-en inaayun din id po-umow si Pablo amoy'd totongko kandin.

Na, to id lihad kos oruwon lahun, si Gubernador Felix novuwassan don ki Porcio Festo. Piru pomon to id kopi-i ni Gubernador Felix no id kahaa-i sikandin taddot mgo ponguu to Judio, waa rin polegguanga si Pablo riyot prisuwan.

footnotes.text: Sokkad ini no ngaran taddot od pompomakoy dangan pomon to ngaran to Nazaret no ingod ni Disas. Woy inin Nazareno, id lomottan to mgo ponguu to Roma, su kunan dan ko duwon ingowollon taddot id sakup tadda nod suvaa kandan.
Ini si Drusila, id ahaw ni Felix pomon diyot unnon sawa rin.
Iddos pinirisu, otid dungguwan don to oruwon lahun no waa nohukumi, ko-ilangan nod polegguangon.
